description: This file contains functions related to energy data analysis, including calculating total energy consumption over specific periods, aggregating site data by group, generating energy benchmarks, computing recent baseline usage, and detecting anomalies based on kWh readings. It interacts with a database through a module named 'db' and includes public APIs for computation and alert creation.

methods.name: float _site_total_kwh(site_id: int, start: datetime, end: datetime)
methods.description: Calculates total kWh for a specific site within a time range by summing interval readings from the database.

methods.name: List[int] _group_site_ids(group_name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of site IDs belonging to a specified benchmark group.

methods.name: Dict[str,object] compute_benchmark(site_id: int, group_name: str, start: datetime, end: datetime)
methods.description: Computes a simple energy benchmark comparing a site's total kWh to the group's average total kWh over a specified period.

methods.name: Optional[Tuple[float,int]] _recent_baseline(site_id: int, meter_id: str, ts: datetime, window_hours: int = 24)
methods.description: Calculates the average kWh over a recent time window for a specific site and meter, excluding the current point, requiring at least 8 data points.

methods.name: Optional[int] maybe_create_anomaly_alert(site_id: int, meter_id: str, ts: datetime, kwh: float)
methods.description: Detects anomalies in energy consumption, such as spikes or drops, based on baseline comparisons and inserts alerts into the database if criteria are met.
